payload.explanation: pg_stat_activity shows the business request (session_a93fb27fe423, pid 877) blocked on a transactionid lock held by session_6bd2aa3cc5d4 (pid 879), which is idle in transaction after executing the same UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1 and is now waiting on ClientRead. The blocker holds the row lock on product_id=1 and never commits, so the waiter cannot proceed. Other idle-in-transaction sessions (session_e34b712ca49a, session_b88b823621a8) block nothing. Indexes and table stats show no redundant-index, vacuum, or large-data issues. Resolution: roll back the eligible blocker session_6bd2aa3cc5d4 to release the lock, preserving the business request. Uncertainty: none material; blocking chain is directly observed.
